name: ssot-mcp
description: Codex skills for SSOT MCP pull-worker campaigns, lease-driven maturity work, conflict-safe slice execution, and MCP-governed registry mutation workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Run SSOT MCP worker campaigns and lease-governed maturity work.
interface.longDescription: Provides Codex with dedicated SSOT MCP skills for pull-only worker campaigns, lease-aware slice execution, T1 direct verification, T2 robustness verification, and T3 certification-closure work. The plugin keeps registry changes on the MCP rail, prevents hand-editing of .ssot/registry.json, and emphasizes honest tier completion, conflict-safe path discipline, and complete_slice-based reporting.
defaultPrompt: Use $ssot-mcp when the work should stay on the SSOT MCP rail instead of direct registry edits.
Use $ssot-mcp-t1-worker-campaign for direct project verification slices targeting T1.
Use $ssot-mcp-t2-worker-campaign or $ssot-mcp-t3-worker-campaign for higher-tier campaign slices.
